nl: Rename the method total of the class Invoice to grand_total, together with its calls on Invoice objects. The method total of Quote and its calls stay unchanged.

entries.content_utf8:
from app.model import Invoice, Quote


def run():
    invoice = Invoice()
    quote = Quote()
    return [invoice.total(), quote.total()]

app/main.py.text:
from app.model import Invoice, Quote


def run():
    invoice = Invoice()
    quote = Quote()
    return [invoice.grand_total(), quote.total()]

p.write_bytes(t.replace('class Invoice:\n    def total(self):', 'class Invoice:\n    def grand_total(self):').encode())
p = pathlib.Path('app/main.py'); t = p.read_bytes().decode()
assert t.count('invoice.total()') == 1, 'app/main.py'
p.write_bytes(t.replace('invoice.total()', 'invoice.grand_total()').encode())
p = pathlib.Path('tests/test_model.py'); t = p.read_bytes().decode()
assert t.count('Invoice().total()') == 1, 'tests/test_model.py'
